newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil futures end firmer, but remain fragile.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil futures end firmer, but remain fragile.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed slightly higher on Thursday as they corrected some of Wednesday's sharp losses, but many traders said the market remained fragile.
July IPE gas oil settled 75 cents higher at $159.50 a tonne having shed $5 on Wednesday, while August Brent was trading just seven cents higher at $17.84 a barrel at 1650 GMT.

"It wasn't surprising to see a bit of a rebound," said a one trader. "But a lot hinges on NYMEX. It's been a bit sluggish over there so far. We really need some confirmation of these gains from the States."
Some traders said the weak state of the physical market also threatened to push gas oil prices lower.
Physical gas oil prices have been under severe pressure over the past few weeks as Russian, Mediterranean and even some trans-Atlantic material has poured into the region.

Many Brent futures traders were similarly bearish after an attempt by the August Brent contract to breach psychological resistance at $18.00 stopped short at $17.97. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714
